data.name: Island Airfields
data.author: dioramawork
data.description:
Land your planes and helicopters on the airfields of your captured islands. They park in the hangars, get repaired, refuelled and rearmed, and take off again when you give them a new order.
How to land: give a flying aircraft one waypoint on your island with an airfield. How to take off: give a parked aircraft a new waypoint.
Needs CC2X (one file, once): put dinput8.dll from CC2X into the game folder - see the mod page. Without it the map shows a yellow line saying so.
Version 1.0. Windows, game version 1.5.18, single player.
